Features

Everything you need to study and remember

One loop: focus, recap out loud, get your summary and next steps.

Pomodoro timer, your rules

Pick your pomodoros, lengths, and a subject color. Whizzy studies right beside you.

Voice recap → AI summary

Say what you learned out loud; the AI turns it into a clean, editable summary.

AI-generated checklists

Your recap becomes tomorrow's next-tasks list, done items already checked off.

Leaderboards & rooms

Climb the global board or race a private room of friends.

Progress graphs

Watch your hours stack up by day, week, and subject.

Streaks & Logs

Five focused minutes keeps your streak alive. Every session adds Logs to the dam.

Study buddies

Meet the Whizzes

Pick who studies with you. They read along while the timer runs and celebrate when you finish.
